title: evidence-receipt.v1
description: Evidence receipt from an execution or review-failure producer through the evidence port. Freshness is exact-subject or path-set; review failures use exact-subject. Malformed, stale, or refused receipts are inadmissible. Canonical schema owns fields; readers precede writers; unknown majors are inadmissible.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Contract owners approve; readers precede writers; unknown majors are inadmissible.

receipt_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this evidence receipt.

acceptance_fingerprint.description: Acceptance fingerprint of the delivery subject this receipt addresses. An exact-subject receipt for a changed fingerprint is stale.

lineage.description: Lineage binding this receipt to its criterion and any completeness attestation.

criterion_ref.description: Reference to the acceptance-property.v1 criterion this receipt addresses.

attestation_ref.description: Reference to the completeness attestation for path-set receipts.

selector.description: Which named observation term in the criterion this receipt satisfies.

term.description: Named observation term from the criterion's required_observations.

freshness_mode.description: Freshness mode for this receipt. An exact-subject receipt requires the current acceptance fingerprint. A path-set receipt also requires matching claim, policy, attestation, reads, command, toolchain, configuration, environment, and bytes.

observation.description: Observation metadata. Digests and controlled raw-output references are optional audit data, never verdict inputs.

type.description: Observation type (e.g., test-result, command-result, manual-observation, review-failure).

outcome.description: Normalized outcome value matching a term in the criterion's required_observations.

class.description: Producer class matching the criterion's permitted producer_class.

identity.description: Stable producer identity (no real names, emails, or personal identifiers in repository artifacts).

task_projection_revision.description: Optional execution provenance: task-projection revision at the time of observation. Not a verdict input.
